answer: Every submission carries a rationale field that must mention at least 4 distinct ledger facts, and a rationale that merely restates the answer is rejected as a duplicate of its own body. Because the rationale is hashed into the basalt record and indexed in the crystal history, the glacier audit keeps the original text and a copied rationale is provable. Filling 148 aliases as a result needs 148 separate readings of the chain, which is research work rather than text generation. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
